BundleAttestation.description:
One record of a bundle: a recorded attestation with a required record id
and bounded text.

Personal data: `attested_by` is a display name, never an email, because it
flows into `evidence_ref` and so into signed artifacts.

attested_at.description: ISO 8601 date, or timestamp with an optional UTC offset
attested_at.title: Attested At

attested_by.description: Display name of the attester; an email address is refused
attested_by.title: Attested By

evidence.description: Pointers to the evidence behind the statement
evidence.title: Evidence

record_id.description: Id of the record the attestation was read from
record_id.title: Record Id

valid_until.description: Last day the attestation counts. From the next day the row reads Unverified until it is renewed. Without it the attestation does not expire.
valid_until.title: Valid Until

BundleAttestation.title: BundleAttestation

BundleEvidence.description: A pointer to the evidence behind a bundled attestation, never the content.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the referenced file, when there is one
sha256.title: Sha256

BundleEvidence.title: BundleEvidence

description:
Active attestations and exclusions for one system, or the whole organisation.

Every top-level field is required, so the signed JSON always carries the
same keys.

attestations.description: Framework key -> requirement id -> attestation. Every attestation carries the `record_id` of its record.
attestations.title: Attestations

additionalProperties.description: Why the requirement does not apply

excluded.description: Framework key -> requirement id -> why the requirement does not apply
excluded.title: Excluded

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset
issued_at.title: Issued At

system_id.description: The system the bundle is for; null for organisation-wide
system_id.title: System Id

title: AttestationBundle
